name: Sara Torabi
abstract_title: Water Charged by the T-Consciousness Charge Field Induces ROS Generation and Reduces Viability in MDA-MB-231 Breast Cancer Cells.
abstract: This study evaluated a novel hypothesis called the T-Consciousness Charge Field (TCCF). It is proposed that any material influenced by this field can become a charged substance capable of carrying information. The TCCF influence is initiated through the mind of an announcer, referred to as a Faradarmangar. This experiment was conducted at the University of Tehran, Iran, to investigate the effects of TCCF-charged water on a cancer cell line. MDA-MB-231 triple-negative breast cancer cell line is h
authors: Sara Torabi, Shima Roshani, Farid Semsarha
field: Plant biology, consciousness fields, water properties
notable: Key collaborator in Taheri Consciousness Fields (TCF) research
notes: Research on effects of T-Consciousness Fields on water and plant antioxidant enzymes.
